hook.from: Geography > Location, Terrain, Natural resources; Economy > Exports
hook.excerpt: East-Central Africa, west of Kenya, east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo || mostly plateau with rim of mountains || landlocked; fertile, well-watered country with many lakes and rivers; Lake Victoria, the world's largest tropical lake and second-largest freshwater lake, is shared among three countries: Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda || Resources: copper, cobalt, hydropower, limestone, salt, arable land, gold || Exports: gold, coffee, fish, refined petroleum, tobacco (2023)

physicalGeography.excerpt: mostly plateau with rim of mountains || East-Central Africa, west of Kenya, east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo

climate.excerpt: tropical; generally rainy with two dry seasons (December to February, June to August); semiarid in northeast || droughts; floods; earthquakes; landslides; hailstorms

economy.excerpt: low-income, primarily agrarian East African economy; COVID-19 hurt economic growth and poverty reduction; lower oil prices threaten prior sector investments; endemic corruption; natural resource rich; high female labor force participation but undervalued || Exports: gold, coffee, fish, refined petroleum, tobacco (2023) || Industries: sugar processing, brewing, tobacco, cotton textiles; cement, steel production

peopleAndCulture.from: People and Society > Languages, Religions, Ethnic groups, Urbanization
peopleAndCulture.excerpt: English (official), Ganda or Luganda (most widely used of the Niger-Congo languages and the language used most often in the capital), other Niger-Congo languages, Nilo-Saharan languages, Swahili (official), Arabic || Protestant 45.1% (Anglican 32.0%, Pentecostal/Born Again/Evangelical 11.1%, Seventh Day Adventist 1.7%, Baptist .3%), Roman Catholic 39.3%, Muslim 13.7%, other 1.6%, none 0.2% (2014 est.) || Baganda 16.5%, Banyankole 9.6%, Basoga 8.8%, Bakiga 7.1%, Iteso 7%, Langi 6.3%, Bagisu 4.9%, Acholi 4.4%, Lugbara 3.3%, other 32.1% (2014 est.)
